south-africa-2003.notes: Source 1: earlier reader saw a 2001 Home.html; our copy's Home.html is 2003. Only 4 crawled pages.

sources.disagreement: Earlier reader found the home page to be the 2001 page; in our copy Home.html states the 2003 contest of 18 October 2003.
sources.evidence: The frameset's home page reads '2003 ACM South Africa Programming Contest sponsored by IBM, hosted by Department of Computer Science, University of Pretoria' with 'Date of Contest: 18 October 2003'.
Page 'View Standings: The 2003 ACM South Africa Programming Contest sponsored by IBM' with a table of 43 team rows, columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved, Time.
Same View Standings page for the 2003 ACM South Africa Programming Contest with 43 team rows and a #Solved column, institution 'University of the Witwatersrand - Johannesburg'.
View Standings table of 43 team rows with only Rank, Team and Citation columns and no solved counts.
14-page PDF headed '5th Southern Africa Regional ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest' with six problem statements, each marked with a balloon colour.
ICPC Live Archive category page 'Regionals 2003 :: Africa/Middle East - South Africa' listing six problems, 2748 to 2753.
Page 'View Standings: The 2005 ACM South Africa Programming Contest sponsored by IBM' with 48 team rows, columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved, Time.
Page headed 'Problem Set' linking six PDFs, ProblemA to ProblemF.
ICPC Live Archive category page 'Regionals 2005 :: Africa/Middle East - South Africa' listing six problems, 3296 to 3301.
